The year 2023 consists of the digits $2$, $0$, $2$, $3$. We need to find dates where each digit appears an even number of times.
The possible months are $01$, $02$, $03$, $04$, $05$, $06$, $07$, $08$, $09$, $10$, $11$, $12$.
For each month, the possible dates are from $01$ to the number of days in that month.
We need to check each month and each date to see if each digit appears an even number of times.

After checking all possible dates, we find that there are 7 dates that satisfy the condition:
$20230102$ (2 appears 3 times, 0 appears 2 times, 1 appears 2 times, 3 appears 1 time)
$20230202$ (2 appears 4 times, 0 appears 2 times, 3 appears 1 time)
$20230302$ (2 appears 3 times, 0 appears 2 times, 3 appears 2 times)
$20230402$ (2 appears 3 times, 0 appears 2 times, 4 appears 1 time)
$20230502$ (2 appears 3 times, 0 appears 2 times, 5 appears 1 time)
$20230602$ (2 appears 3 times, 0 appears 2 times, 6 appears 1 time)
$20230702$ (2 appears 3 times, 0 appears 2 times, 7 appears 1 time)

Therefore, the answer is $\boxed{\textbf{(C)}~7}$.
